content.text: Waking at 2am comes up fairly often at 8, especially in stretches. Worries, a busy head, or a change like summer schedules and later bedtimes can all set it off. Tonight, try a short wind-down with a few minutes of calm talk before lights out. Ask Ada what's on their mind, and let them park any worries on a "tomorrow list" by the bed. If they wake, keep it boring: a quick check-in, lights low, and back to bed with no screens.
